svg.text: Dragon Q6A 40-pin header · Gravity GNSS on I2C6
Colours match the header on the board · pin 1 = square pad · 2.54 mm pitch
Connection — header pins 1–6 to GNSS P3 (PH2.0 4-pin)
so SDA/SCL stay at the header's 3.3 V logic level.
Module P3 pin order per the Bearing wiring reference (verified on hardware).
Connect by signal, not by position.
Wire colours are the Gravity cable convention — on any other cable, check colour → signal with a meter first.
Linux (I2C6 is off in the stock device tree)
Pins 3/5 are QUP0 SE6 → node i2c6 (i2c@998000) in kodiak.dtsi; the board DT does not enable it.
Probe: i2cdetect -y N → device at 0x20. Clock 100 kHz, same as the Bearing firmware.
Header GPIO is 3.3 V logic (3.63 V max) — never drive a signal pin from 5 V.
Pins 8/10 (UART5) carry the ttyMSM0 serial console — keep them free.
Pins 2/4 are 5 V; the GNSS does not use them.
Set the module's I2C/UART selector to I2C before power-up.
